narr: A cold front moved through the area during the evening hours of April 13th. As the front reached the New Orleans metro, it slowed slightly. This slowing along with a fairly wide swath of intense rainfall resulted in street flooding across the city of New Orleans.
ev: The local emergency manager reported several streets and a few underpasses to be closed due to high water.
lsr: SEVERAL STREETS FLOODED AND A FEW UNDERPASSES CLOSED DUE TO HIGH WATER.
